panels.description: Seconds since the latest exported slot sample. Higher values usually mean the watcher is stalled or Prometheus is scraping stale data.

panels.description: On-chain voting liveness for every observed watched validator. ACTIVE means Solana reports the vote account in the current set. DELINQUENT means it is not keeping up with cluster voting. This does not probe the validator's private RPC process.
panels.title: Watched Validator Liveness

panels.description: Highlights watched validators that are starting to miss leader opportunities.

targets.expr: clamp_max((max((100 * sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"} / clamp_min(sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"} + sol_watched_validator_blocks_produced{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, 1)) > bool 5) or vector(0)) + (max((100 * sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"} / clamp_min(sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"} + sol_watched_validator_blocks_produced{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, 1)) > bool 10) or vector(0)), 2)

panels.title: Watched Skip State

panels.description: Count of watched validators that are delinquent, have more than 32 slots of last-vote lag, or exceed a 5% skip rate. Conditions are unioned by validator so active validators with lag or skip issues remain visible and overlapping conditions count once.

targets.expr: count((max by (network, identity, vote_account) (sol_watched_validator_info{identity=~"$validator",network="$network",status="delinquent"}) > 0) or (max by (network, identity, vote_account) (sol_watched_validator_last_vote_slot_lag{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}) > 32) or (max by (network, identity, vote_account) (100 * sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"} / clamp_min(sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"} + sol_watched_validator_blocks_produced{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, 1)) > 5)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Validators Needing Attention

panels.description: Sortable operator view for every watched validator, positioned directly below live operator state.

targets.expr: max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_info{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_activated_stake_sol{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_vote_efficiency_pct{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_last_vote_slot_lag{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_root_slot_lag{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_commission_pct{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_blocks_produced{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))

100 * max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account")) / clamp_min(max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_blocks_produced{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account")) + max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account")), 1)

panels.title: Watched Validators

panels.description: Seconds since the latest complete watcher snapshot. No data means this runtime has not published a snapshot.
panels.title: Snapshot Age

panels.description: Health reported by the configured node-local RPC endpoint relative to the cluster tip. NOT CONFIGURED means this profile has no node-status route; UNAVAILABLE means the route exists but supplied no current node series.

targets.expr: min by (network) (sol_node_health{network="$network"}) or ((max by (network) (sol_mode_command_route_info{network="$network",mode="health",command="node-status"}) * 0 - 2) unless on (network) sol_node_health{network="$network"}) or ((max by (network) (sol_watcher_up{network="$network"}) * 0 - 1) unless on (network) sol_mode_command_route_info{network="$network",mode="health",command="node-status"})

panels.title: Node Health

panels.description: Slots the node-local RPC endpoint reports behind the cluster tip. No data means the endpoint did not supply a structured distance.

targets.expr: max by (network) (sol_node_catchup_distance_slots{network="$network"}) or ((max by (network) (sol_mode_command_route_info{network="$network",mode="health",command="node-status"}) * 0 - 2) unless on (network) sol_node_health{network="$network"}) or ((max by (network) (sol_watcher_up{network="$network"}) * 0 - 1) unless on (network) sol_mode_command_route_info{network="$network",mode="health",command="node-status"})

panels.title: Catch-up Distance

panels.description: Block height reported by each configured node-local RPC endpoint.

targets.expr: max by (network, identity) (sol_node_block_height{network="$network"}) or on (network) label_replace(((max by (network) (sol_mode_command_route_info{network="$network",mode="health",command="node-status"}) * 0 - 2) unless on (network) sol_node_block_height{network="$network"}), "identity", "unavailable", "", "") or on (network) label_replace(((max by (network) (sol_watcher_up{network="$network"}) * 0 - 1) unless on (network) sol_mode_command_route_info{network="$network",mode="health",command="node-status"}), "identity", "not configured", "", "")

panels.title: Node Block Height

panels.description: Whether every configured node identity appears in the current Solana vote-account set.

targets.expr: min by (network) (max by (network, identity) (sol_node_info{network="$network",voting_status="current"}) or (max by (network, identity) (sol_node_info{network="$network",voting_status=~"delinquent|not-found"}) * 0)) or ((max by (network) (sol_mode_command_route_info{network="$network",mode="health",command="node-status"}) * 0 - 2) unless on (network) sol_node_info{network="$network"}) or ((max by (network) (sol_watcher_up{network="$network"}) * 0 - 1) unless on (network) sol_mode_command_route_info{network="$network",mode="health",command="node-status"})

panels.title: Node Voting

targets.expr: max by (network, identity, version, feature_set, voting_status) (sol_node_info{network="$network"})

max by (validator_key, network, identity, vote_account, status, version, feature_set, shred_version) (label_join(sol_watched_validator_gossip_info{identity=~"$validator",network="$network"}, "validator_key", " / ", "network", "vote_account"))
